phrases.english: Honestly, I’d rather plan lightly today.
phrases.norwegian: Ærlig talt, jeg vil heller planlegge litt i dag.

phrases.english: I want to feel calm, not rushed.
phrases.norwegian: Jeg vil føle meg rolig, ikke stresset.

phrases.english: Let’s check in, what are you actually feeling?
phrases.norwegian: La oss sjekke inn, hva føler du egentlig?

phrases.english: I respect your pace, we don’t have to hurry.
phrases.norwegian: Jeg respekterer tempoet ditt, vi trenger ikke haste.

phrases.english: Some days I’m low-energy, so simple wins.
phrases.norwegian: Noen dager er jeg lavenergi, så enkelt vinner.

phrases.english: If you’re unsure, say it, we’ll figure it out.
phrases.norwegian: Hvis du er usikker, si det, så finner vi det ut.

phrases.english: I’m feeling better, can we make a plan?
phrases.norwegian: Jeg føler meg bedre, kan vi lage en plan?

phrases.english: It’s okay to want comfort, not big gestures.
phrases.norwegian: Det er greit å ville ha trygghet, ikke store gester.

phrases.english: Let’s keep the mood gentle, no pressure.
phrases.norwegian: La oss holde stemningen myk, ingen press.

phrases.english: I don’t need perfection, I need honesty.
phrases.norwegian: Jeg trenger ikke perfeksjon, jeg trenger ærlighet.

phrases.english: Sometimes plans scare me, but we can still go.
phrases.norwegian: Noen ganger skremmer planer meg, men vi kan dra likevel.

phrases.english: I’d rather talk first, then set the schedule.
phrases.norwegian: Jeg vil heller snakke først, så setter vi tidspunktet.

phrases.english: I’m proud you’re trying, even if it’s messy.
phrases.norwegian: Jeg er stolt av at du prøver, selv om det blir rotete.

phrases.english: Let’s be patient, feelings take time.
phrases.norwegian: La oss være tålmodige, følelser tar tid.

phrases.english: I want to listen, not rush the decision.
phrases.norwegian: Jeg vil lytte, ikke haste med valget.

phrases.english: If today’s hard, we can reschedule kindly.
phrases.norwegian: Hvis i dag er vanskelig, kan vi ta det på nytt, pent.

phrases.english: I’m honest: I miss you, want to meet?
phrases.norwegian: Ærlig talt: jeg savner deg, vil vi møtes?

phrases.english: Let’s not overdo it, just one real plan.
phrases.norwegian: La oss ikke gjøre det for mye, bare én plan som betyr noe.

phrases.english: I’m choosing peace, so let’s keep it simple.
phrases.norwegian: Jeg velger ro, så vi holder det enkelt.

phrases.english: We’ll adjust with grace, not blame.
phrases.norwegian: Vi tilpasser oss med raushet, ikke skyld.

phrases.english: Thanks for being real, it makes planning easier.
phrases.norwegian: Takk for at du er ekte, det gjør planlegging enklere.

phrases.english: What day suits you best, tomorrow or Friday?
phrases.norwegian: Hvilken dag passer deg best, i morgen eller fredag?

phrases.english: Start now, don’t overthink, just do it
phrases.norwegian: Start nå, ikke overtenk, bare gjør det

phrases.english: It’s okay, breathe, try again, you’ll improve
phrases.norwegian: Det er helt greit, pust, prøv igjen, du blir bedre

phrases.english: Yes, exactly, that’s the right direction
phrases.norwegian: Ja, helt riktig, det er riktig retning

phrases.english: No worries, we’ll figure it out together
phrases.norwegian: Ingen bekymring, vi finner det ut sammen

phrases.english: Good job, you nailed it, nice work
phrases.norwegian: Skikkelig bra, du traff blink, kjempebra jobbet

phrases.english: Wait, listen, that’s a smart idea
phrases.norwegian: Vent, hør her, det er en smart idé

phrases.english: Let’s go, small steps, big results
phrases.norwegian: Vi kjører, små steg, store resultater

phrases.english: Keep your head up, you’re doing great
phrases.norwegian: Hodet opp, du gjør det skikkelig bra

phrases.english: Really? Nice, that’s awesome news
phrases.norwegian: Er det sant? Så bra, det var kjempebra

phrases.english: Thanks, I appreciate it, that helps a lot
phrases.norwegian: Takk, jeg setter pris på det, det hjelper mye

phrases.english: I’m on it, give me a minute, I got you
phrases.norwegian: Jeg er på det, gi meg et minutt, jeg ordner det

phrases.english: That makes sense, go ahead, try it
phrases.norwegian: Det gir mening, bare kjør, prøv det

phrases.english: Sorry, my bad, let’s reset and continue
phrases.norwegian: Beklager, det var min feil, la oss starte på nytt

phrases.english: Watch this, quick tip, you’ll feel confident
phrases.norwegian: Se her, et kjapt tips, du blir trygg

phrases.english: I’ll keep trying, one more time, for sure
phrases.norwegian: Jeg prøver igjen, en gang til, det går

phrases.english: Nice timing, perfect, you nailed it again
phrases.norwegian: Nydelig timing, helt perfekt, du traff igjen

phrases.english: Yes, let’s meet halfway, we’ll work it out
phrases.norwegian: Ja, vi møtes på midten, vi ordner det sammen

phrases.english: No problem, take your time, I can wait
phrases.norwegian: Det går bra, ta det rolig, jeg kan vente

phrases.english: That’s true, you’re right, I agree
phrases.norwegian: Det stemmer, du har rett, jeg er enig

phrases.english: I knew it, that’s exactly what I meant
phrases.norwegian: Jeg visste det, det var akkurat det jeg mente

phrases.english: Make it happen, start simple, build from there
phrases.norwegian: Få det til, start enkelt, bygg videre

phrases.norwegian: Hvordan går det? Dette høres bra ut

phrases.english: You’re improving, keep practicing, it will click
phrases.norwegian: Du blir bedre, fortsett å øve, det klikker

phrases.english: That’s enough, stop now, do the next step
phrases.norwegian: Nå er det nok, stopp nå, ta neste steg

phrases.english: Really quick, tell me the plan
phrases.norwegian: Si det kjapt, hva er planen?

phrases.english: Good point, let’s decide, then we move
phrases.norwegian: Godt poeng, la oss bestemme, så går vi videre

phrases.english: Don’t quit, you’re closer than you think
phrases.norwegian: Ikke gi opp, du er nærmere enn du tror

phrases.english: All right, let’s do it, right now
phrases.norwegian: Greit, vi gjør det, med en gang

phrases.english: That’s perfect, just like that, keep it up
phrases.norwegian: Det er helt perfekt, sånn ja, stå på

phrases.english: What’s the best time to study today?
phrases.norwegian: Hva er den beste tiden å studere i dag?

phrases.english: Can you help me choose a goal?
phrases.norwegian: Kan du hjelpe meg å velge et mål?

phrases.english: How do you stay focused during busy days?
phrases.norwegian: Hvordan holder du deg fokusert i travle dager?

phrases.english: What do you recommend for faster progress?
phrases.norwegian: Hva anbefaler du for raskere framgang?

phrases.english: Could you repeat that, please, more slowly?
phrases.norwegian: Kan du gjenta det, vær så snill, litt saktere?

phrases.english: When should I ask for feedback, exactly?
phrases.norwegian: Når bør jeg spørre om tilbakemelding, helt konkret?

phrases.english: Do you think this plan will work?
phrases.norwegian: Tror du denne planen vil fungere?

phrases.english: What’s your shortcut for learning quickly?
phrases.norwegian: Hva er din snarvei for å lære raskt?

phrases.english: Which habit matters most for success here?
phrases.norwegian: Hvilken vane betyr mest for suksess her?

phrases.english: Where can I find reliable practice materials?
phrases.norwegian: Hvor kan jeg finne pålitelige øvingsmaterialer?

phrases.english: If I get stuck, what should I do?
phrases.norwegian: Hvis jeg står fast, hva bør jeg gjøre?

phrases.english: How would you explain this in simple words?
phrases.norwegian: Hvordan ville du forklare dette med enkle ord?

phrases.english: Is it better to practice daily or weekly?
phrases.norwegian: Er det bedre å øve hver dag eller hver uke?

phrases.english: What’s one change that will make a difference?
phrases.norwegian: Hva er én endring som kan gjøre en forskjell?

phrases.english: Can we talk about your next step?
phrases.norwegian: Kan vi snakke om ditt neste steg?

phrases.english: Would you mind checking my progress soon?
phrases.norwegian: Kan du sjekke framgangen min snart, hvis du vil?

phrases.english: What should I prepare before our meeting?
phrases.norwegian: Hva bør jeg gjøre klart før møtet?

phrases.english: How do you handle setbacks without quitting?
phrases.norwegian: Hvordan takler du tilbakeslag uten å gi opp?

phrases.english: Can you suggest a small task for today?
phrases.norwegian: Kan du foreslå en liten oppgave for i dag?

phrases.english: What’s the simplest way to start this?
phrases.norwegian: Hva er den enkleste måten å starte dette på?

phrases.english: Do you want to try a new approach?
phrases.norwegian: Vil du prøve en ny måte å gjøre det på?

phrases.english: Where do you usually get motivation from?
phrases.norwegian: Hvor får du som regel motivasjonen fra?

phrases.english: What if my schedule changes, what now?
phrases.norwegian: Hva om timeplanen endrer seg, hva gjør vi da?

phrases.english: Could you give me one clear example?
phrases.norwegian: Kan du gi meg ett tydelig eksempel?

phrases.english: Which mistake should I avoid this time?
phrases.norwegian: Hvilken feil bør jeg unngå denne gangen?

phrases.english: How often should I review to stay sharp?
phrases.norwegian: Hvor ofte bør jeg repetere for å holde meg skarp?

phrases.english: Do you prefer feedback first, or later?
phrases.norwegian: Vil du heller ha tilbakemelding først, eller etterpå?

phrases.english: What’s the next question you need answered?
phrases.norwegian: Hva er det neste spørsmålet du trenger svar på?

phrases.english: Can I ask you something about your plan?
phrases.norwegian: Kan jeg spørre deg om planen din?

phrases.english: How did you decide on that goal?
phrases.norwegian: Hvordan bestemte du deg for det målet?

phrases.english: Small steps count, du blir sterkere
phrases.norwegian: Små steg teller, du blir sterkere

phrases.english: Trust yourself, you’ve got this today
phrases.norwegian: Tro på deg selv, du klarer det i dag

phrases.english: Breathe, focus, and move forward—ikke gi opp
phrases.norwegian: Pust, fokuser, og gå videre, ikke gi opp

phrases.english: You’re building skills, not just studying
phrases.norwegian: Du bygger ferdigheter, ikke bare lesing

phrases.english: Keep your head up, progress is real
phrases.norwegian: Hold hodet høyt, fremgang er ekte

phrases.english: Today counts, do one thing well
phrases.norwegian: I dag teller, gjør én ting ordentlig

phrases.english: Mistakes are clues, learn and go again
phrases.norwegian: Feil er signaler, lær og prøv igjen

phrases.english: Say it out loud, you’ll remember faster
phrases.norwegian: Si det høyt, så husker du fortere

phrases.english: Be proud, even the messy practice matters
phrases.norwegian: Vær stolt, selv den rotete øvingen teller

phrases.english: One more rep, you’re getting closer
phrases.norwegian: En ekstra repetisjon, du er nærmere

phrases.english: Your effort shows, keep going steadily
phrases.norwegian: Innsatsen din merkes, stå på

phrases.english: Get comfortable with being a beginner
phrases.norwegian: Bli vant til å være nybegynner

phrases.english: You’re allowed to learn slowly, still win
phrases.norwegian: Du får lære sakte, og likevel vinne

phrases.english: Celebrate progress, not perfection
phrases.norwegian: Feir framgang, ikke perfeksjon

phrases.english: Let curiosity drive you, ask simple questions
phrases.norwegian: La nysgjerrighet styre deg, spør enkelt

phrases.english: You don’t need motivation first, start anyway
phrases.norwegian: Du trenger ikke motivasjon først, start likevel

phrases.english: Small wins today, bigger confidence tomorrow
phrases.norwegian: Små seire i dag, større selvtillit i morgen

phrases.english: Be kind to yourself, you’re working hard
phrases.norwegian: Vær snill mot deg selv, du jobber hardt

phrases.english: Keep the promise you made to yourself
phrases.norwegian: Hold løftet du ga deg selv

phrases.english: When it’s hard, that’s where growth begins
phrases.norwegian: Når det er vanskelig, der begynner vekst

phrases.english: Give yourself credit, you’re showing up
phrases.norwegian: Gi deg selv honnør, du møter opp

phrases.english: Your routine is your secret superpower
phrases.norwegian: Rutinen din er din hemmelige superkraft

phrases.english: Learn, then rest, then learn again
phrases.norwegian: Lær, så ta pause, og lær igjen

phrases.english: Keep it simple, consistency beats intensity
phrases.norwegian: Hold det enkelt, jevn innsats slår alt

phrases.english: Say “jeg kan”, and start the next task
phrases.norwegian: Si “jeg kan”, og start neste oppgave

phrases.english: You’re allowed to improve in public
phrases.norwegian: Du får lov til å bli bedre foran folk

phrases.english: Stay curious, every sentence is progress
phrases.norwegian: Hold deg nysgjerrig, hvert ord er framgang

phrases.english: Positive thoughts make practice easier
phrases.norwegian: Positive tanker gjør øving lettere

phrases.english: You’re not behind, you’re on your way
phrases.norwegian: Du er ikke sen, du er på vei

phrases.english: Be honest, your feelings are valid, always.
phrases.norwegian: Vær ærlig, følelsene dine er gyldige, alltid.

phrases.english: Reflect quietly, then choose your next move.
phrases.norwegian: Reflekter stille, og velg neste steg.

phrases.english: Patience pays off, progress comes in waves.
phrases.norwegian: Tålmodighet lønner seg, fremgang kommer i bølger.

phrases.english: When you doubt, slow down and breathe.
phrases.norwegian: Når du tviler, senk farten og pust rolig.

phrases.english: Your effort matters, even if results wait.
phrases.norwegian: Innsatsen din betyr noe, selv om resultater tar tid.

phrases.english: Let the day be imperfect, keep going.
phrases.norwegian: La dagen være litt uperfekt, fortsett likevel.

phrases.english: You don’t have to feel ready, just begin.
phrases.norwegian: Du trenger ikke å føle deg klar, bare start.

phrases.english: Talk to yourself kindly, you’re learning, period.
phrases.norwegian: Snakk til deg selv med vennlighet, du lærer, punktum.

phrases.english: Name the feeling, it gets easier.
phrases.norwegian: Sett ord på følelsen, da blir det lettere.

phrases.english: Choose meaning over speed, every time.
phrases.norwegian: Velg mening framfor tempo, hver eneste gang.

phrases.english: Small wins soothe your mind, then you act.
phrases.norwegian: Små seire roer hodet, så handler du.

phrases.english: It’s okay to pause, you’re not stuck.
phrases.norwegian: Det er greit å ta en pause, du er ikke stuck.

phrases.english: Trust the process, not the mood of today.
phrases.norwegian: Tro på prosessen, ikke på dagens humør.

phrases.english: Ask what you need, then adjust gently.
phrases.norwegian: Spør hva du trenger, og juster forsiktig.

phrases.english: Keep your standards human, not perfect.
phrases.norwegian: Hold standarden menneskelig, ikke perfekt.

phrases.english: Some days, focus on understanding, not output.
phrases.norwegian: Noen dager, fokuser på forståelse, ikke produksjon.

phrases.english: Turn setbacks into questions, then write answers.
phrases.norwegian: Gjør motgang om til spørsmål, og skriv svar.

phrases.english: Be brave with mistakes, they teach you fast.
phrases.norwegian: Vær modig med feil, de lærer deg fort.

phrases.english: Your emotions are data, use them wisely.
phrases.norwegian: Følelsene dine er data, bruk dem klokt.

phrases.english: I’m proud of trying, not just winning.
phrases.norwegian: Jeg er stolt av å prøve, ikke bare å vinne.

phrases.english: Give yourself room, growth takes time.
phrases.norwegian: Gi deg selv plass, vekst tar tid.

phrases.english: Be patient with grammar, it clicks later.
phrases.norwegian: Vær tålmodig med grammatikk, det sitter senere.

phrases.english: If it feels heavy, break it down.
phrases.norwegian: Hvis det føles tungt, del det opp.

phrases.english: Your goal is real, even on slow days.

phrases.english: Don’t hide your effort, language needs practice.
phrases.norwegian: Skjul ikke innsatsen, språk trenger øving.

phrases.english: Choose one truth, then act on it.
phrases.norwegian: Velg én sannhet, og handle etter den.

phrases.english: You’re allowed to feel nervous, still study.
phrases.norwegian: Du får lov til å være nervøs, og likevel lære.

phrases.english: Pause, then return with a calmer mind.
phrases.norwegian: Ta en pause, og kom tilbake med roligere sinn.

phrases.english: Say it clearly, your voice builds confidence.
phrases.norwegian: Si det tydelig, stemmen din bygger selvtillit.

phrases.english: Success is showing up, with honest energy.
phrases.norwegian: Suksess er å møte opp, med ærlig energi.

phrases.english: Start small today, finish what you start.
phrases.norwegian: Start i det små i dag, fullfør det du begynner.

phrases.english: Say it out loud, even if it’s awkward.
phrases.norwegian: Si det høyt, selv om det føles litt knotete.

phrases.english: Are you okay, do you feel dizzy?
phrases.norwegian: Er du ok, føler du deg svimmel?

phrases.english: Help me, I think I’m having trouble breathing.
phrases.norwegian: Hjelp meg, jeg tror jeg får problemer med pusten.

phrases.english: Call a doctor, this started really suddenly.
phrases.norwegian: Ring en lege, det startet veldig brått.

phrases.english: Stay with me, don’t go anywhere.
phrases.norwegian: Bli med meg, ikke dra noen steder.

phrases.english: What happened, are you in severe pain?
phrases.norwegian: Hva skjedde, har du sterke smerter?

phrases.english: I feel sick, is there a restroom nearby?
phrases.norwegian: Jeg føler meg dårlig, finnes det toalett her?

phrases.english: Do you need water, can I get some?
phrases.norwegian: Trenger du vann, kan jeg hente litt?

phrases.english: Please, just take it easy, okay?
phrases.norwegian: Vær så snill, ta det rolig, ok?

phrases.english: Do you know where the pharmacy is?
phrases.norwegian: Vet du hvor apoteket er?

phrases.english: I think it’s an allergy, my eyes are itchy.
phrases.norwegian: Jeg tror det er en allergi, øynene klør.

phrases.english: Can you check my temperature, please?
phrases.norwegian: Kan du sjekke temperaturen min, vær så snill?

phrases.english: I’m getting worse, we should go now.
phrases.norwegian: Jeg blir verre, vi bør dra nå.

phrases.english: Does anyone have painkillers, by chance?
phrases.norwegian: Har noen smertestillende, ved en tilfeldighet?

phrases.english: I cut my finger, it won’t stop bleeding.
phrases.norwegian: Jeg har kuttet fingeren, det slutter ikke å blø.

phrases.english: Put pressure here, keep your hand steady.
phrases.norwegian: Trykk her, hold hånden rolig.

phrases.english: Is there an emergency exit nearby?
phrases.norwegian: Er det en nødutgang i nærheten?

phrases.english: I need an ambulance, please call.
phrases.norwegian: Jeg trenger ambulanse, kan du ringe?

phrases.english: What’s your name, and where do you live?
phrases.norwegian: Hva heter du, og hvor bor du?

phrases.english: I have a headache, it’s really strong.
phrases.norwegian: Jeg har vondt i hodet, det er skikkelig sterkt.

phrases.english: My stomach hurts, I can’t keep eating.
phrases.norwegian: Jeg har vondt i magen, jeg kan ikke spise.

phrases.english: Let’s sit down, you look pale.
phrases.norwegian: La oss sette oss ned, du ser blek ut.

phrases.english: Are you still feeling dizzy, after breathing?
phrases.norwegian: Føler du deg fortsatt svimmel, etter at du puster?

phrases.english: I’m not feeling well, I need fresh air.
phrases.norwegian: Jeg føler meg ikke bra, jeg trenger frisk luft.

phrases.english: Slow down, breathe with me, please.
phrases.norwegian: Pust rolig, pust sammen med meg, vær så snill.

phrases.english: Where is the nearest clinic, please?
phrases.norwegian: Hvor er den nærmeste legevakten?

phrases.english: Can someone translate, this is hard for me.
phrases.norwegian: Kan noen oversette, dette er vanskelig for meg.

phrases.english: I might have food poisoning, it started tonight.
phrases.norwegian: Jeg tror jeg har matforgiftning, det startet i kveld.

phrases.english: Don’t touch it, I think it’s dangerous.
phrases.norwegian: Ikke rør det, jeg tror det er farlig.

phrases.english: Is this pain getting worse, or staying the same?
phrases.norwegian: Blir denne smerten verre, eller den samme?

phrases.english: Do you know what triggered it, earlier today?
phrases.norwegian: Vet du hva som trigget det, tidligere i dag?

phrases.english: Should I call someone, or wait it out?
phrases.norwegian: Bør jeg ringe noen, eller vente?

phrases.english: Can you tell me what you feel, exactly?
phrases.norwegian: Kan du si hva du føler, helt nøyaktig?

phrases.english: Have you had this before, or is it new?
phrases.norwegian: Har du hatt dette før, eller er det nytt?

phrases.english: Where does it hurt the most, right now?
phrases.norwegian: Hvor gjør det mest vondt, akkurat nå?

phrases.english: Is there swelling, redness, or warmth nearby?
phrases.norwegian: Er det hevelse, rødhet, eller varme der?

phrases.english: What should I do first, in your opinion?
phrases.norwegian: Hva bør jeg gjøre først, etter din mening?

phrases.english: Do I need to bring any medicine with me?
phrases.norwegian: Må jeg ta med medisiner, i så fall?

phrases.english: Can you help me write down symptoms?
phrases.norwegian: Kan du hjelpe meg å skrive ned symptomene?

phrases.english: When did it start, roughly, this morning?
phrases.norwegian: Når startet det, omtrent, i morges?

phrases.english: Is your breathing normal now, or slower?
phrases.norwegian: Er pusten normal nå, eller saktere?

phrases.english: Should I take a photo of the rash?
phrases.norwegian: Bør jeg ta et bilde av utslettet?

phrases.english: Do you know if it’s contagious?
phrases.norwegian: Vet du om det smitter?

phrases.english: Have you taken anything, like pills or drops?
phrases.norwegian: Har du tatt noe, som piller eller dråper?

phrases.english: Can you ask me questions, one by one?
phrases.norwegian: Kan du spørre meg, én ting av gangen?

phrases.english: What’s the best way to stay calm here?
phrases.norwegian: Hva er den beste måten å roe seg ned her?

phrases.english: Is this suitable for kids, or not?
phrases.norwegian: Er dette greit for barn, eller ikke?

phrases.english: Do you think I should go to urgent care?
phrases.norwegian: Tror du jeg bør dra til legevakt?

phrases.english: Can I get a quick check, please?
phrases.norwegian: Kan jeg få en rask sjekk, takk?

phrases.english: Do I need stitches, or is it minor?
phrases.norwegian: Trenger jeg sting, eller er det ikke så farlig?

phrases.english: Should I keep it covered, or let it air?
phrases.norwegian: Bør jeg holde det dekket, eller lufte det?

phrases.english: Is the patient allowed to eat or drink?
phrases.norwegian: Er det greit å spise eller drikke nå?

phrases.english: Could this be heat exhaustion, maybe?
phrases.norwegian: Kan det være heteslag, kanskje?

phrases.english: What signs mean I should not wait?
phrases.norwegian: Hvilke tegn betyr at jeg ikke bør vente?

phrases.english: Is it okay to take ibuprofen in my case?
phrases.norwegian: Er det greit å ta ibuprofen i mitt tilfelle?

phrases.english: Can you repeat that slowly, please?
phrases.norwegian: Kan du gjenta det sakte, vær så snill?

phrases.english: Where can I get advice, right now?
phrases.norwegian: Hvor kan jeg få råd, akkurat nå?

phrases.english: What should I bring, when we go in?
phrases.norwegian: Hva bør jeg ta med, når vi går inn?

phrases.english: Thanks, I understand, what’s the next step?
phrases.norwegian: Takk, jeg skjønner, hva er neste steg?

phrases.english: You’re doing great, let’s keep it simple.
phrases.norwegian: Du gjør det kjempebra, vi tar det enkelt.

phrases.english: It’s okay, focus on your breathing now.
phrases.norwegian: Det er helt greit, fokuser på pusten nå.

phrases.english: Say it out loud, I’m safe right now.
phrases.norwegian: Si det høyt, jeg er trygg akkurat nå.

phrases.english: Slow thoughts, strong body, one step at a time.
phrases.norwegian: Rolige tanker, sterk kropp, ett steg om gangen.

phrases.english: You’ve handled tough moments before, you can again.
phrases.norwegian: Du har taklet tøffe ting før, du klarer det igjen.

phrases.english: Stay with me, we’ll get through this.
phrases.norwegian: Vær her med meg, vi ordner dette sammen.

phrases.english: Right now, focus on what feels better.
phrases.norwegian: Akkurat nå, fokuser på det som føles bedre.

phrases.english: You’re not alone, help is on the way.
phrases.norwegian: Du er ikke alene, hjelpen er på vei.

phrases.english: Keep your shoulders down, relax and reset.
phrases.norwegian: Ha skuldrene nede, slapp av og start på nytt.

phrases.english: We’ll take small steps, that’s enough.
phrases.norwegian: Vi tar små steg, det holder.

phrases.english: Good job, you stayed calm and focused.
phrases.norwegian: Så bra, du holdt deg rolig og fokusert.

phrases.english: Your body is working, trust that process.

phrases.english: Let fear pass, you’re in safe hands.
phrases.norwegian: La frykten slippe, du er i trygge hender.

phrases.english: Focus on comfort, one decision at a time.
phrases.norwegian: Fokuser på det behagelige, én avgjørelse om gangen.

phrases.english: I believe you, we can do this together.
phrases.norwegian: Jeg tror på deg, vi klarer dette sammen.

phrases.english: You’re doing your best, that matters a lot.
phrases.norwegian: Du gjør ditt beste, det betyr mye.

phrases.english: Make room for hope, keep going.
phrases.norwegian: Gi plass til håp, ikke gi deg.

phrases.english: In your head, count slowly, then breathe out.
phrases.norwegian: I hodet ditt, tell rolig, pust så ut.

phrases.english: Good call, you asked for help early.
phrases.norwegian: Veldig bra, du ba om hjelp i tide.

phrases.english: We’ll get through this, no panic needed.
phrases.norwegian: Vi kommer oss gjennom dette, ingen panikk.

phrases.english: Your calm voice helps the body settle.
phrases.norwegian: En rolig stemme hjelper kroppen å roe seg.

phrases.english: Right now, choose patience over worry.
phrases.norwegian: Nå velger du tålmodighet framfor uro.

phrases.english: You’re safe, we’ll monitor things step by step.
phrases.norwegian: Du er trygg, vi følger med, steg for steg.

phrases.english: Keep sipping water slowly, if it’s allowed.
phrases.norwegian: Ta små slurker vann, hvis det er lov.

phrases.english: You’ve got this, even if it feels scary.
phrases.norwegian: Du klarer dette, selv om det føles skummelt.

phrases.english: Focus on the next minute, not the whole day.
phrases.norwegian: Fokuser på neste minutt, ikke hele dagen.

phrases.english: Thank you, I see how hard you’re trying.
phrases.norwegian: Takk, jeg ser hvor mye du prøver.

phrases.english: It’s okay to ask questions, we’ll slow down.
phrases.norwegian: Det er greit å spørre, vi tar det roligere.

phrases.english: You’re making progress, keep your eyes forward.
phrases.norwegian: Du er på vei mot bedring, hold blikket fremover.

phrases.english: Right now, breathe, relax, and trust us.
phrases.norwegian: Nå, pust, slapp av, og stol på oss.

phrases.english: I’m scared, but I’m staying honest with you.
phrases.norwegian: Jeg er redd, men jeg er ærlig med deg.

phrases.english: Tell me what you’re feeling, I’ll listen.
phrases.norwegian: Si meg hva du føler, jeg lytter.

phrases.english: We can go step by step, no rush.

phrases.english: It matters how you feel, not just symptoms.

phrases.english: I’m proud of you, even if it hurts.
phrases.norwegian: Jeg er stolt av deg, selv om det gjør vondt.

phrases.english: Let’s be patient, your body needs calm.
phrases.norwegian: La oss være tålmodige, kroppen din trenger ro.

phrases.english: I notice your tone, you sound worried.
phrases.norwegian: Jeg merker tonen din, du høres bekymret ut.

phrases.english: I want to check in, how’s your head?
phrases.norwegian: Jeg vil sjekke inn, hvordan er hodet ditt?

phrases.english: No judgment, just tell me the truth.
phrases.norwegian: Ingen dømming, bare si sannheten.

phrases.english: I’ll stay close, even if thoughts race.
phrases.norwegian: Jeg blir her, selv om tankene dine løper.

phrases.english: You can admit it hurts, that’s okay.

phrases.english: I feel this is serious, let’s act gently.

phrases.english: Take a breath, then be honest with me.
phrases.norwegian: Ta et pust, så vær ærlig med meg.

phrases.english: I understand, you’re trying your best right now.
phrases.norwegian: Jeg skjønner det, du gjør så godt du kan nå.

phrases.english: Don’t force strength, we’ll slow it down together.

phrases.english: Your feelings guide us, tell me clearly.
phrases.norwegian: Følelsene dine hjelper oss, si det tydelig.

phrases.english: I’m here, even when you’re overwhelmed.

phrases.english: If you’re dizzy, say it, don’t hide.

phrases.english: Your gut feeling matters, tell me honestly.

phrases.english: I can see you’re trying, don’t blame yourself.

phrases.english: Let it out, your fear doesn’t run things.
phrases.norwegian: La det komme ut, frykten din styrer ikke alt.

phrases.english: I believe you, your symptoms feel real.

phrases.norwegian: Jeg hører på deg, og vi velger tålmodighet over panikk.

phrases.norwegian: Hvis det er alvorlig, ring 113, med en gang.

phrases.english: Say where you are, I’ll connect you.
phrases.norwegian: Si hvor du er, så kobler jeg deg.

phrases.norwegian: Ta av ringer, kjøl det, og dekk til forsiktig.

phrases.norwegian: Ingen stress, vi fikser det, ok?

phrases.norwegian: Vet du hva, glem det, det går bra.

phrases.english: That’s my vibe, I like this, yep.
phrases.norwegian: Dette er min vibe, jeg liker det, ja.

phrases.english: Go for it, try it, you got this.
phrases.norwegian: Kjør på, prøv det, du klarer det.

phrases.english: Not my thing, sorry, I’m out.

phrases.norwegian: Det er irriterende, seriøst, slutt.

phrases.english: Keep it cool, don’t flip out, ok?

phrases.english: Thanks a lot, that helped, really.
phrases.norwegian: Tusen takk, det hjalp, skikkelig.

phrases.english: Does this work for you, today?
phrases.norwegian: Funka dette for deg i dag?

phrases.english: Can you explain it, like, step by step?
phrases.norwegian: Kan du forklare det, liksom, steg for steg?

phrases.norwegian: Er vi på for i kveld, eller ikke?

phrases.norwegian: Så, hva er planen, da?

phrases.english: How come you’re late, did something happen?
phrases.norwegian: Hvorfor er du sen, skjedde det noe?

phrases.english: Where are you headed, after this?
phrases.norwegian: Hvor går du, etter dette?

phrases.english: Did you already check, or should I?
phrases.norwegian: Har du sjekket, eller skal jeg?

phrases.norwegian: Hva er den raskeste måten å gjøre dette på?

phrases.english: You got a minute, I need advice.

phrases.english: Why not, sounds fair to me.
phrases.norwegian: Hvorfor ikke, det høres rett ut for meg.

phrases.english: How bad is it, really?
phrases.norwegian: Hvor ille er det, egentlig?

phrases.english: Do you have time, or am I rushing?
phrases.norwegian: Har du tid, eller stresser jeg nå?

phrases.english: Can we swap, you take this one?
phrases.norwegian: Kan vi bytte, du tar den her?

phrases.english: What if we just wait, for a sec?
phrases.norwegian: Hva om vi bare venter, et øyeblikk?

phrases.english: Do you know where that store is?
phrases.norwegian: Vet du hvor den butikken ligger?

phrases.english: Should I bring money, or card only?
phrases.norwegian: Må jeg ha kontanter, eller holder kort?

phrases.english: Are you serious, about doing that?
phrases.norwegian: Mener du det seriøst, da?

phrases.english: How’s it going, everything good with you?
phrases.norwegian: Hvordan går det, er alt bra med deg?

phrases.english: Can you repeat that, I missed it.
phrases.norwegian: Kan du si det igjen, jeg hørte ikke?

phrases.english: So, you coming, right now, yes?
phrases.norwegian: Så, kommer du nå, sant?

phrases.english: Small steps count, don’t overthink it.

phrases.english: Breathe, reset, you’ve got this.

phrases.english: You’re learning, not failing, remember that.

phrases.english: That’s progress, even if it’s messy.
phrases.norwegian: Det der er framgang, selv om det er rotete.

phrases.english: Give yourself credit, you earned it.
phrases.norwegian: Gi deg selv litt skryt, du fortjente det.

phrases.english: Today’s just one round, go again.
phrases.norwegian: I dag er bare én runde, prøv igjen.

phrases.english: Don’t spiral, pick one thing, start.
phrases.norwegian: Ikke gå i spiral, velg én ting, start.

phrases.english: You’re stronger than your doubts, seriously.
phrases.norwegian: Du er sterkere enn tvilen din, seriøst.

phrases.english: It’s okay to be slow, stay steady.
phrases.norwegian: Det er greit å gå sakte, hold kursen.

phrases.english: Say it out loud, you can do it.
phrases.norwegian: Si det høyt, du får det til.

phrases.english: Keep the vibes up, small wins matter.
phrases.norwegian: Hold stemningen oppe, små seire teller.

phrases.english: You’ve come this far, don’t stop now.
phrases.norwegian: Du har kommet så langt, ikke stopp nå.

phrases.english: Mess up, learn fast, repeat tomorrow.

phrases.english: Trust the process, it takes time.
phrases.norwegian: Stol på prosessen, det tar tid.

phrases.english: No pressure, just try your best, today.
phrases.norwegian: Ingen press, bare gjør ditt beste, i dag.

phrases.english: You’re allowed to take breaks, ok?
phrases.norwegian: Du får lov å ta pauser, ok?

phrases.english: That’s a win, celebrate it for real.
phrases.norwegian: Det der er en seier, feir det skikkelig.

phrases.english: You’re not stuck, you’re just learning.
phrases.norwegian: Du sitter ikke fast, du lærer bare.

phrases.english: Keep your head up, things improve.

phrases.english: One more try, that’s the magic.
phrases.norwegian: Et forsøk til, det er magien.

phrases.english: You don’t need perfect, just consistent.
phrases.norwegian: Du trenger ikke perfekt, bare jevnt.

phrases.english: Stay kind to yourself, you’re doing fine.
phrases.norwegian: Vær snill med deg selv, du har det bra.

phrases.norwegian: Bekymre deg senere, for nå, gå videre.

phrases.english: You’re getting there, don’t doubt it.
phrases.norwegian: Du er på vei, ikke tvil.

phrases.english: Keep going, even when it’s awkward.

phrases.norwegian: I dag skinner du, i morgen lærer du mer.

phrases.english: I’m not okay, but I’m handling it.

phrases.english: Quick question, what time starts?

phrases.english: I’m on my way, be there soon.
phrases.norwegian: Jeg er på vei, jeg er der snart.

phrases.english: Let’s grab coffee after work, yeah?

phrases.english: All set, everything is ready.

phrases.english: That was loud, sorry!

phrases.english: Do you want to help me?

phrases.english: Let’s tidy up, right now.
phrases.norwegian: La oss rydde opp, nå.

phrases.english: We’ll do it later, promise.

phrases.english: Give me a hug, please.

phrases.english: Thanks, that really helps.

phrases.english: I’ll clean it up, don’t worry.
phrases.norwegian: Jeg rydder opp, ikke bekymre deg.

phrases.english: What do you need for tomorrow at home?

phrases.english: Could you check the laundry, please?

phrases.english: Do you want tea or coffee today?

phrases.english: How was school, what happened today?

phrases.english: Should we buy more snacks for guests?

phrases.english: What’s for dinner, do you know yet?

phrases.english: Hey, I’m calling about your order.
phrases.norwegian: Hei, jeg ringer om bestillingen din.
phrases.transliteration: HEI, je RINGER om BES-TIL-LIN-gen din.

phrases.english: Can you call me back, please?
phrases.norwegian: Kan du ringe meg tilbake, vær så snill?
phrases.transliteration: KAN du RING-e meg TIL-bake, vær så SNILL?

phrases.english: I just sent you a message.
phrases.norwegian: Jeg har nettopp sendt deg en melding.
phrases.transliteration: JEI har NETT-opp SENDT deg en MEL-ding.

phrases.english: Sorry I missed your call.
phrases.norwegian: Beklager at jeg savnet samtalen din.
phrases.transliteration: BEK-la-ger at JEI SAV-net SAM-ta-len din.

phrases.english: What time will you be free today?
phrases.norwegian: Når er du ledig i dag?
phrases.transliteration: NÅR er du LE-dig i DAG?

phrases.english: Do you have a moment to talk?
phrases.norwegian: Har du et øyeblikk til å snakke?
phrases.transliteration: HAR du et ØYE-blikk til å SNAK-ke?

phrases.english: I’m stuck in traffic, running late.
phrases.norwegian: Jeg sitter fast i køen, jeg kommer sent.
phrases.transliteration: JEI SIT-ter FAST i KØ-en, je KOM-mer SENT.
